# Welcome

Hi, I'm Miguel Osorio Gonzalez, Associate Director at Horizon Media in advertising, while pursuing my MS in Business Analytics at Baruch College (expected Summer 2026).

I code daily in SQL, with strong experience in Python and R plus deep expertise in data visualization, and returned to graduate school to sharpen my technical edge amid AI's rapid evolution. Beyond balancing a full-time role with three graduate courses, I'm learning Mandarin to become conversational and visit China in the coming years.

On this site, you'll find examples of my coursework, mini-projects from STA 9750, and hands-on work with R and Quarto exploring real-world datasets to answer practical questions and communicate actionable insights clearly.

![Headshot of me](miguel-headshot.jpg){fig-align="center" width="200"}



You can connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguelosoriogonzalez/).
